description: Trainer integration in runtime/run.py: cascade train/deform steps with skip, cascade validation with frozen-stage baselines and val_pair_chunk (NIT 1), BN recalibration (NIT 2), plus the local cascade-beats-frozen test. Plan items 4-7. Depends on FEAT-001 (models/cascade.py, TINY, TrainConfig fields). Every non-cascade path stays byte-identical (goldens).
steps: Read design.md §4-§8, §15, §16 T5-T7, T9, T16b, plan.md items 4-7 and the NIT 1-3 notes, and FEAT-001 findings first.

Trainer.__init__(..., cascade=None): store self.cascade (a FrozenStage or None); never add its variables to the optimizer (O.build_optimizer stays on self.model.trainable_variables). Update the class/module docstrings.

_make_train_step: cascade branch chosen at trace time (`if self.cascade is not None`) exactly per §4: after pp() and the in_finite zeroing, A_prev = self.cascade.linear(x, task) outside the tape; if cfg.cascade_skip_prob > 0: A_prev = cascade.skip_linear(skip, A_prev); x_in = cascade.prewarp_linear(x, A_prev, P.LEVEL_SPACING[level]); inside the tape out = model(x_in, ...), A = cascade.compose_linear(out['A_raw'], A_prev, model.centering), terms = losses.linear_loss(A, batch, S, lam) (objective, weights, AMP, grad norm as today); collapse_diagnostics on the trainable stage. Input signature gets a trailing tf.TensorSpec([], tf.bool) 'skip' only in the cascade branch. Non-cascade body/signature untouched.

_make_deform_step: cascade branch per §5 (prev = self.cascade.deform(x) outside the tape; skip_fields when p>0; x_in = cascade.prewarp_deform(x, U); inside the tape out = model(x_in, 'deform', training=True); u, u_inv = diffeo.compose_cascade(U, U_inv, out['u'], out['u_inv']); out_c = dict(out, u=u, u_inv=u_inv, u_res=out['u']); losses.deform_loss(out_c, batch, ...) with the ORIGINAL batch images/one-hot; deform_diagnostics(out_c) plus diag_u_res_max_vox). The cascade deform step always has the 2-input signature + skip (residual affine is excluded by the parser).

train_step(task, batch_tuple, skip=False): non-cascade call unchanged; cascade appends tf.constant(bool(skip)) (§6). fit: draw skip = random.Random('cascade-skip-%d-%d' % (cfg.seed, s)).random() < p only when cascade and p > 0; log train/cascade_skip_frac window mean only when p > 0; with a cascade also accumulate train_<task>/data_ms and train_<task>/compute_ms window means and train_deform/diag_u_res_max_vox.

Validation (§8): _val_fn / _val_deform_fn cascade branches (pool -> frozen eval -> pre-warp -> trainable (eval, or train-mode BN with restored stats as today) -> compose), traced once per key, frozen recomputed inside the tf.function; cascade _val_fn returns {'A','A_prev'} in eval and {'A'} in train mode; cascade _val_deform_fn adds U, U_inv, V in eval only; non-cascade functions unchanged. _val_errors / _val_deform_errors branch at Python level and collect frozen_outs in eval mode with a cascade. New _frozen_baseline_metrics(name, vs, groups, frozen_outs) cached by (name, len(groups)): linear M.group_errors(A4, ...) -> M.summarize(..., 'val_%s_frozen' % name) (affine factor errors for affine sets), deform _deform_errors(labels, U, U_inv, V, V, ...) -> val_deform_frozen/*. Add val_deform/composed_mean_disp_mm (RMS over voxels of |mean_i u_i| in mm) only with a cascade. NIT 1: _deform_errors(..., chunk=None, images=None) with chunk = int(self.cfg.val_pair_chunk if chunk is None else chunk); callers do not pass chunk.

recalibrate_bn(num_batches, freeze, val=True) exactly per §7 steps 1-7 and §15 rows (RuntimeError without cascade; bnrecal_pre/ and bnrecal_post/ validation records at step 0 with PNGs temporarily off; largest-remainder plan interleaved round-robin; NIT 2: b = global plan index 0..K-1 for self.controls[t].update(b) only if t in self.controls, docstring states fit restarts at update(0) and that recalibration consumes K source batches and K postprocess draws; one draw per slot, non-finite consumes the slot (stderr warning, skipped_nonfinite), 0 used -> RuntimeError, StopIteration -> RuntimeError('bn recalibration: source <task> exhausted'); eager tape-free forward of the cascade input path with model(x_in, task, training=True); exact average via m.bn.momentum = c/(c+1) per BatchNormWithSeparateAffine of the parts the task runs, originals saved per layer and restored in finally; layers_without_updates must be [] else RuntimeError; freeze -> model.set_bn_stats_frozen(True) + rebuild_steps(); logs and returns the bn_recalibration event dict with the gap table ({} when val=False)). Never touches trainable variables, optimizer slots or self.step; never touches the frozen stage.

tests/test_cascade.py: add T5 TestFrozenStageTraining, T6 TestSkip (identity test p=0 vs p=0.5 with skip=False under tests.test_trainer._OpDeterminism and TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0, target max |diff| 0, docstring pins the 1e-6 relative fallback per NIT 3; strict graph check: no op name starting 'cascade_skip' in the p=0 traced graphs; forced skip -> prewarp input == raw images / U == 0; alternating skip no retrace; skip_frac logged; validate() identical for p=0 and p=0.9), validation subtests (baseline keys finite, cache hit, NIT 1: identity and frozen baselines honour val_pair_chunk=4), T7 TestBNRecal (every subtest of §16 T7 incl. the MANDATORY exact-average check, gradient_checkpointing='both' per-layer update count, a layer with a different momentum restored to its own value, non-finite slot, all-slots non-finite RuntimeError, val=False empty gap, val=True pre/post records + gap keys, cascade=None RuntimeError), T9 step part (one cascade deform + one affine step under mixed_float16: finite, u/u_inv/A float32, frozen variables float32; restore policy), T16b TestCascadeBeatsFrozen exactly per §16 16b (print margins).

Run verification; set status completed; findings: T7 gap numbers, T16b margins (composed vs frozen center RMS and template Dice), whether the T6 bitwise identity held (or the fallback tolerance was needed), any signature that FEAT-003/004 must call (recalibrate_bn return value, _frozen_baseline_metrics keys, timing keys).
acceptance_criteria: tests.test_cascade passes completely (T1-T7, T9, T16b, validation subtests) with BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000
tests.test_trainer passes completely; TestLinearOnlyUnchanged and TestDeformUnchanged report max |diff| 0
cascade=None trainers keep today's step input signatures (asserted in T5)
py_compile + ast feature_version (3,8) OK for runtime/run.py and tests/test_cascade.py in bgr_preproc38
verification: .agents/tmp/ut.sh with: tests.test_trainer (includes the goldens; check the stderr max |diff| 0 lines)
findings: DONE (no commit, no cluster). Files: runtime/run.py (cascade paths), tests/test_cascade.py (+16 tests: TestFrozenStageTraining, TestSkip x4, TestCascadeValidation x2, TestBNRecal x7, TestCascadeAMP, TestCascadeBeatsFrozen), design.md section 7 step 3 (NIT 2 sentence). VERIFICATION (GTX 1080, BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000, TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0): tests.test_cascade 27/27 OK (26 in one module run of 1738 s + TestCascadeAMP rerun after its fix; TestBNRecal rerun after the last run.py edit, 7/7 OK); tests.test_trainer 50/50 OK in 2552 s with '[golden] max |diff| 0' and '[golden deform] max |diff| 0'; py_compile + ast (3,8) OK on runtime/run.py and tests/test_cascade.py in bgr_preproc38; `python main.py --help` still OK there. run.py stays ASCII-only (the FEAT-001 TrainConfig comment's section sign was replaced too). MEASURED: T6 off-path identity max |diff| 0 over 9 losses + 94 variable sums, BUT only with Grappler's meta optimizer off (test context manager _GrapplerOff): with Grappler on, the mere presence of the SelectV2 skip ops changes Grappler's rewrites of the deform step (max |var diff| 8.6e-8 after the first deform step, Adam-amplified to ~1.5 % of a loss after 3 rounds), while two p=0 trainers stay bitwise equal; so the mismatch is traced to the skip ops' graph, not their values, and the NIT-3 1e-6 fallback was NOT used. Report must record this. T7: exact average max rel. error 1.76e-7 (mandatory check holds: Keras 2.10 fused BN re-reads momentum per eager call); gradient_checkpointing='both': exactly 1 BN update per layer and batch (class-level call counter) and the exact average holds; gap with stats of x1 inputs on x3 data, rigid only: center_rms 0.3543 -> 0.00047 mm, pair_rms 0.4937 -> 0.00073 mm; three-task gap (random level-4 stats, flips on, informational): rigid center 0.132 -> 0.196, pair 0.196 -> 0.328, affine center 0.056 -> 0.069, pair 0.076 -> 0.106 mm (post > pre because the shared encoder statistics are averaged over three different synthetic groups), deform template Dice 3.3e-4 -> 6.4e-5, pair 6.2e-5 -> 3.1e-4. T16b margins (train-mode stats, flips off): rigid center RMS composed 6.882 mm vs frozen 12.759 mm (margin 5.877; step-0 composed 13.884); deform template hard Dice composed 0.9729 vs frozen 0.9409 (margin 0.0319; identity 0.9297, step-0 composed 0.9567). LOCAL LIMITS (important for FEAT-003/004/005): a level-2 deform TRAINING step does not fit 6000 MB even at TINY N=2 with integration_steps 7 (no checkpointing, 'integrator' or cascade/no-cascade all OOM; 'both' fits at 5.7 GB). The trainer tests therefore use tiny_config(deform_decoder=True, seed=1, integration_steps=3), gradient_checkpointing='both' for the level-2 model and n_classes=9 (peak ~2.9 GB, ~2.1 s per deform step, ~0.8 s per rigid step N=4, ~25 s per level-2 step trace). FEAT-003's e2e / main-level tests at level 2 need the same (--integration-steps 3 --gradient-checkpointing both, n_classes per data) or they will OOM. Several OOMs were in allocator gpu_host_bfc: the int32 index arithmetic of layers.sample_voxel_coords (tf.cast(..., tf.int32), int32 AddV2/Mul) runs in HOST memory on GPU devices in TF (int32 GPU kernels are HostMemory), which also makes level-2 warps CPU-bound; worth watching in the cluster memory job's step times (possible later fix: int64 indices), not changed here (out of scope). test_cascade now takes ~30 min, so the full suite will be ~2 h (FEAT-005 timeout). DEVIATIONS: none in behaviour. Trainer.__init__ additionally raises ValueError for a cascade whose level != PREV_LEVEL[level], for cascade + deform_residual_affine, and for cascade_skip_prob outside [0,1) (defence in depth). recalibrate_bn raises ValueError (from bn_recal_plan) when K < number of tasks. layers_without_updates = layers of the used parts whose moving statistics are bitwise unchanged (a repeated recalibration reproducing the current statistics exactly would also be flagged; never the case on a fresh run). API FOR FEAT-003/004: Trainer(..., cascade=FrozenStage); train_step(task, batch_tuple, skip=False); runtime.run.cascade_skip_draw(seed, step, p); runtime.run.bn_recal_plan(K, ratio) -> list of task names; Trainer.recalibrate_bn(num_batches, freeze, val=True) -> event dict {'event': 'bn_recalibration', 'num_batches', 'planned': {task: n}, 'batches': {task: used}, 'skipped_nonfinite': {task: n}, 'n_layers_updated', 'layers_without_updates': [], 'elapsed_s', 'freeze', 'gap': {'gap_pre/<set name>/<metric>', 'gap_post/<set name>/<metric>'}} (set name = val_sets key, e.g. rigid / affine / rigid_g / deform; metrics center_rms_mm, pair_rms_mm for linear sets, template_dice, pair_dice for deform sets; {} when val=False), also logged via logger.log_event(step, event); the step-0 records are 'bnrecal_pre/<validate key>' and 'bnrecal_post/<validate key>' (e.g. bnrecal_pre/val_rigid/center_rms_mm, bnrecal_post/val_deform_trainmode/pair_dice, bnrecal_pre/val_affine_frozen/center_rms_mm). Validation keys with a cascade: every val_<set>/... is COMPOSED; frozen baselines 'val_<set>_frozen/<every M.summarize key>' (linear: center_/pair_rms_mm (+_p95), rot_deg, trans_mm, cycle_rms_mm, affine sets also center_/pair_{scale_pct, shear_pct, qr_rot_deg}; deform: template_dice, pair_dice, neg_jac_pct, inv_consistency_mm, inv_consistency_max_mm, centrality_mm, raw_centrality_mm, ncc_template, ncc_pair) cached in Trainer._frozen_cache by (name, len(groups)); deform sets also 'val_<set>/composed_mean_disp_mm' (eval only). Training log keys with a cascade: train_<task>/data_ms, train_<task>/compute_ms (window means), train_deform/diag_u_res_max_vox; 'train/cascade_skip_frac' (runtime.run.CASCADE_SKIP_KEY) only when cascade_skip_prob > 0; history records carry 'cascade_skip' (bool) only then. _deform_errors(labels, u, u_inv, v, v_raw, seed, chunk=None, images=None) (chunk None = cfg.val_pair_chunk; measure_level_memory.py should pass chunk=16 explicitly). Cascade val functions: _val_fn(task, nv, train_mode) -> {'A','A_prev'} (eval) / {'A'} (train mode); _val_deform_fn(nv, train_mode) -> {u,u_inv,v,v_raw,U,U_inv,V} (eval) / {u,u_inv,v,v_raw} (train mode); both traced once per key. tests/test_cascade.py helpers for FEAT-003: CascadeTrainerCase (stages(), make(cfg, sources, val_sets, logger, amp, cascade_on, gradient_checkpointing), val_sets(scale), logger(name), records(logger)), cascade_config(**kw), STAGE_KW, STAGE_CKPT, N_CLASSES, _GrapplerOff, CountingSource, bn_stats(model, parts), block_mode (preprocessing.export.block_mode, numpy fallback because tf_gpu lacks nibabel).
